diagnostic_evidence.quote: \mathcal{I}_\theta:=\left\{T^{\prime} \in[0, T]: \Upsilon\left(T^{\prime}\right):=\sup _{t \in\left[0, T^{\prime}\right]} y_1(t)+\int_0^{T^{\prime}} y_2(t) \ d t \leq \theta\right\}.
\sup _{t \in[0, T]} y_1(t)+\int_0^T y_2(t) \ d t \leq \delta A E .

issues.failure_explanation: The only quantity the proof bounds is y1(T′)+∫_0^{T′}y2 (exactly the left-hand side of (nonlin_term)); it then asserts that this forces Υ(T_M)<θ where Υ(T′)=sup_{t≤T′}y1(t)+∫_0^{T′}y2. But sup y1 + ∫y2 can be up to twice sup_t(y1(t)+∫_0^t y2), so the inference is invalid. The proposition is genuinely false: take T=1, y1(t)=1−t, y2≡1, a≡0, A=1, B=0.1, β=1. Then (nonlin_term) reads 1 ≤ 1+0.1(T′−T′²/2) and holds for all T′∈[0,1]; with δ=3/2, E=1, condition (cond_prop31) reads 1.5 < (0.5)/(0.15)=3.33 and is satisfied; yet sup y1+∫y2 = 1+1 = 2 > 1.5 = δAE.

failure_location.quote: This implies $\Upsilon\left(T_M\right)<\theta$, hence $T_M=T$, and thus proves the Lemma if $A>0$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Re-run the continuation argument with the quantity Υ(T′)=sup_{t≤T′}(y1(t)+∫_0^t y2), which satisfies Υ(T′)≤2(A+BTθ^{1+β})E, and re-solve the smallness condition accordingly (equivalently absorb the factor 2 into A and B and require δ>2). All results then persist in the same form with adjusted constants.
issues.overall_effect: The quantitative conclusions of Proposition adj_gengronwall, of Theorem stab_thm and of item i) of Theorem main_thm are unproved and in general false as written: the certified size of sup‖ρ−ρ̄‖²_{L²}+∫|ρ−ρ̄|²_{H¹} can exceed the claimed δAE by up to a factor 2. The a posteriori verifiable existence conclusions (Proposition apostverif, Corollary cor:added-1) survive, since they only need the bound to be finite.
issues.title: Adjusted Gronwall lemma concludes a bound on sup y1 + ∫y2 from a bound on y1(T′) + ∫y2
issues.why_classification: The repair is a contained constant reoptimization of an existing argument (factor 2 plus a correspondingly adjusted smallness condition); the method, the conditional nature of the estimates, the rates and the advertised scope all survive unchanged, so the loss is limited rather than structural.

issues.failure_explanation: Estimate (noncomp_esti) bounds only the pointwise-in-time quantity ‖e(t)‖²+∫_{t^n}^t|e|². From it one gets sup_{t∈[t^n,t^*]}(‖e(t)‖²+∫_{t^n}^t|e|²) ≤ A_nE_nH_n(t^*), but the displayed step claims the larger quantity sup_t‖e(t)‖²+∫_{t^n}^{t^*}|e|², which is bounded by twice that. The same defect therefore invalidates the local estimate Ψ_n = δ_nA_nE_n and hence the conclusion of Theorem stab_cont (and item ii) of Theorem main_thm), independently of ISSUE-001 because this derivation uses only the classical Gronwall lemma.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redo the continuation argument bounding sup_{s∈[t^n,t]}‖e‖²+∫_{t^n}^t|e|² by 2A_nE_nH_n(t), and redefine δ_n through the correspondingly adjusted root equation (e.g. 2exp(BΔt^nθ²) ≤ δ_n); the step-wise and global estimates then hold with the same structure and modified constants.
issues.overall_effect: The local-in-time estimate and the global conclusion of Theorem stab_cont, and therefore item ii) of Theorem main_thm, are unsupported and in general false as stated (at least a factor-2 loss in the certified error bound). Corollary cor:added-2 is unaffected, since it only requires the bound to be finite.
issues.title: Local-in-time continuation bounds sup‖e‖²+∫|e|² by an estimate for ‖e(t)‖²+∫|e|²
issues.why_classification: A contained reoptimization of the continuation threshold and of the root condition repairs the argument while keeping the local-in-time framework, the root existence criterion and the rate intact; no new global architecture or loss of regime is required.

issues.failure_explanation: Splitting the ℓ₁⁰ part as −∫ρ̃⁰∇c̃⁰·∇φ = −∫ρ̃¹∇c̃⁰·∇φ + ∫(ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰)∇c̃⁰·∇φ and then writing ∇c̃⁰ = ∇c_h⁰ + ∇(c̃⁰−c_h⁰), the consistency term enters as +∫(ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰)∇(c̃⁰−c_h⁰)·∇φ ≤ +‖ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰‖_{L^∞}‖c̃⁰−c_h⁰‖_{H¹} ≤ +‖ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰‖_{L^∞}η⁰_Ω. The stated bound subtracts this nonnegative quantity (and omits the factor ℓ₁⁰(t)), so it is smaller than what the argument yields and can fail as an upper bound.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: In Lemma conv-res0 replace −‖ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰‖_{L^∞}η⁰_Ω by +ℓ₁⁰(t)‖ρ̃¹−ρ̃⁰‖_{L^∞}η⁰_Ω (or simply drop the term) and re-sum the bounds when defining Σ_K Θ²_{K,0} in Theorem main_thm.
issues.overall_effect: The n=0 contribution to the computable residual bound (estimator) in Theorem main_thm is not established: Θ_{K,0} under-covers the convective residual on the first time slab, so the advertised fully computable a posteriori estimator is not validated there.
issues.title: Early-time convective residual bound carries the wrong sign on the η⁰_Ω term
issues.why_classification: The correction is a local sign/weight fix inside one lemma; after it, every claim, the estimator formula and all guarantees of Theorem main_thm survive unchanged apart from a slightly larger n=0 residual contribution.
